description.en: Select note text to open a frosted nine-color palette, tint a real multiline selection, and return to recently colored passages.
description.zh: 选择笔记文字，唤出磨砂九色调色器；跨行选区随颜色变化，并可跳回最近上色的段落。

keywords: 文字 选区 调色器 颜色 笔记 备忘录 荧光 历史 磨砂 notes text color selection palette highlight typography

discovery.caveat: 将颜色选择结果接入目标编辑器，核对选区与持久化行为。

source.implementation: Independent DOM, Selection/Range, CSS and GSAP reconstruction from observed video frames.
source.license: Original design/source license not supplied or verified; the original video and author source are not redistributed.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Drag to select text, double-click a word, or tap a colored phrase. Pick a color or revisit a recent selection. Focus a paragraph and press Enter for keyboard controls; Notes resets the demo.
instructions.zh: 拖选文字、双击单词，或轻触已上色短语。选择颜色，或点击最近选区跳回；聚焦段落后按 Enter 使用键盘操作，Notes 可重置演示。
